features.quote: Each trial is one debugging episode lasting a fixed number of turns, e.g. 24–40 turns.
Do not let the model exit early just because it thinks it is done. Require a fixed number of turns
features.justification_quote: The loop should be long enough for a shift to emerge if it exists.

features.quote: Stop at: - fixed solution - max turns reached - repeated identical failure for N turns - model explicitly requests stopping
